heading_en: Standards for Approval of the Special Exclusion from Calculation of the ILM
summary_ja: ILMの算出に係る除外特例を承認する際の四つの審査基準を定める。
summary_en: Sets four standards the Commissioner applies in approving the special exclusion from the ILM calculation.
paragraphs: When the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency intends to grant the approval under Article 295, the Commissioner shall examine whether all of the following standards are met. (i) That the special loss is not related to the business currently conducted. (ii) That the Ultimate Designated Parent Company does not currently conduct business similar to the business that gave rise to the special loss and there is no risk of recurrence. (iii) That the amount of the special loss exceeds 5% of the annual average of all operational risk losses arising in the relevant measurement period. (iv) That the special loss has been recorded in the internal loss database for at least three years.
